title: Shape Race puzzle
description: One Shape Race picture (m13 s20): the pieces a player fits into their outlines on the board. The guide is docs/levels.md; the rules a file must keep are in packages/puzzle_game/lib/src/puzzle_rules.dart, run by tools/level.sh check.

$schema.description: The schema this file follows, so VS Code autocompletes the fields and marks mistakes as you type. Write "puzzle.schema.json".

format.description: The puzzle format the file is written in (m13 s20). Today it is 1; a file with a newer format is refused by an older app with a message saying so.

id.description: The puzzle's id, matching its file name (sun.json has id "sun") and the line in index.json. Lower case letters, digits and hyphens.

name.description: The name players see, in title case: "Tree and sun".

level.errorMessage: {value} is not a level: use easy or medium
level.description: Easy: 4-5 pieces, at most 2 turned, no two pieces of the same shape and size. Medium: 6-8 pieces, 1 or 2 big, at most one pair of the same shape. Hard is not used yet: "hard" is not a level: use easy or medium.

notes.description: A comment for the puzzle's author. The app ignores it; the template's instructions are written here.

pieces.description: The picture's pieces, drawn in this order: a later piece is over an earlier one (a window over a wall).

number.description: A board unit: the board is 80 wide and 72 high, with (0, 0) at its top left and y growing downwards (docs/levels.md).

pair.description: Two numbers: [width, height] in board units.

id.description: The piece's id, unique in the puzzle: "body", "wheel front". Lower case, spaces allowed.

kind.description: Pieces of one kind are interchangeable and must have the same shape (the boat's two waves). Omit it: each piece is its own kind.

shape.description: The piece's outline, around its centre (0, 0), in board units.

oneOf.description: A circle: the radius in board units.
A regular polygon: [corners, radius], the first corner straight up.

regular.description: [corners, radius]: at least 3 corners, a radius above 0.

prefixItems.description: The distance from the centre to a corner.

oneOf.description: A shape drawn corner by corner: [[x, y], ...], at least 3 corners.

color.description: A colour token from docs/levels.md ("red", "sky", "silver") or "#RRGGBB". A piece stands out from the board in both looks and from the puzzle's other pieces.

at.description: Where the outline's centre lies on the board, in board units: [x, y].

angle.description: The angle the piece belongs at, in degrees clockwise (the default 0). Only needed for a shape drawn sideways.

rotated.description: true: the piece may start at a random angle, so it must be turned. Easy allows at most 2 of them.

big.description: true: a big piece, which two players carry together. Medium has 1 or 2.
